pages.title: IM A GIRLY Kayla Doll - MULTI
pages.description: The Im A Girly trendy Swiss-designed fashion dolls build a bridge between childhood and teenage years, creating strong role models and inspiring children to live out their individual ideas and fantasies. Each dolls hair is interchangeable so you can create new styles. Meet Kayla. Shes super sporty and loves making new friends. She loves street style and playing volleyball. Comes dressed in this bright blue tracksuit and trendy trainers.
